title: FleetQualificationApprovedPayload
description: Payload of `fleet.qualification.approved` version 1. The Partner approved a qualification for an Agent: jobs needing it may be given to them, and their shifts make slots for it. The envelope's `partner_id` is the Agent's Partner. No payload carries a phone number, an email address or a document number. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

user_id.description: The Agent's person; `null` for the simulator's Agents.

name.description: The qualification, as the Partner wrote it.

key.description: Lower case with single spaces: what jobs are matched on.

by.description: Who did it: a member of the Partner or Mission Control; `null` for the platform.
